description: Adds customers to the connected Nexwin account, up to 200 in one call, from a list the user has pasted or uploaded. The receptionist then recognises them by phone number when they call. A row whose phone number or email already belongs to a customer is skipped, as is a row with no first name; the result says how many of each. Existing customers are never changed. Nobody is contacted. Executes immediately.

notes.description: Anything the receptionist should know about this customer

phone.description: Include the country code or leading 0, e.g. 0412 345 678

name: import_customers

_environment.description: The Nexwin country and environment that supplied the result

title: Import customers
